state_machine._comment_respawn_confirm_frames: Consecutive frames the respawn hint must persist before switching TO the video.
state_machine._comment_result_confirm_frames: Consecutive frames 胜利/战败 must persist before switching back to the game.

companion._comment_url: Any web page opened while you are dead (a 'companion' page for downtime). Video sites (Douyin/Bilibili/Kuaishou) get play/pause control; ANY other site (Xiaohongshu, a blog, an academic page) just opens and is shown/hidden with no side effects. Presets: Douyin https://www.douyin.com | Bilibili https://www.bilibili.com | Kuaishou https://www.kuaishou.com. Empty string disables companion switching entirely (you drive the page yourself).
companion._comment_fullscreen: true = maximize the companion window on show (fullscreen-window mode).
companion._comment_browser_path: Optional explicit chrome.exe / msedge.exe path. Empty = 'chrome.exe' on PATH with common install-location fallbacks. The companion opens in an isolated --user-data-dir so it never touches your real browser, and login state persists across runs.

media._comment_cdp_port: The companion browser is launched with --remote-debugging-port=<cdp_port>. Play/pause is driven via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), which can reach background / paused / live tabs that the old GSMTC approach could not. If the port is unreachable (e.g. the browser was already open without remote debugging), it falls back to GSMTC.
media._comment_video_host: Optional URL-substring filter: only page tabs whose URL contains this string are controlled (e.g. 'bilibili.com'). Empty = control every page tab. Leave empty unless you specifically want to limit scope.
